segments.orig: ⸢IGI⸣.2-ia ki-i ad-ku-ú UR.SAG {d}U.GUR ina GIŠ.GU.ZA LUGAL-ú-ti a-ši-ib a-gu-u LUGAL-ú-ti a-⸢pi⸣-ir ina ŠU.2-šú ki-lál-le-e 02 GIŠ.mì-i-ṭi{?} ŠÚR-MEŠ ṣa-bit 02-a.a SAG.DU-MEŠ {d}⸢x⸣+[x x]+⸢x⸣ DU [x]
segments.en: When I raised my eyes, (I saw) the valiant Nergal seated on a regal throne, apparelled with the royal tiara; with both hands he grasped two grim maces, each with two ... heads.

segments.en: [......] were heaped [upon] them. Lightning was flashing in ... his arms, the Anunnaki, the great gods, knelt to his right and left [...].

segments.orig: a-ra-al-lu ma-li pu-luḫ-tu i-na pa-an DUMU NUN-e na-di ši-iš{?}-šú dan-nu [x x x ina] a-bu-sa-ti-ia iṣ-bat-an-ni-ma a-na maḫ-ri-šú ú-qar-[ri]-⸢ban{?}⸣-ni
segments.en: The nether world was full of terror; a mighty silence lay before the crown prince [...]. He took me by my forelock and pulled me in front of him.

segments.orig: [a]-mur-šu-ma i-tar-ru-ra iš-da-a.a me-lam-mu-šu ez-zu-ti is-ḫu-pu-u-ni GÌR.2 DINGIR-ti-šú [GAL]-⸢ti⸣ áš-šiq-ma ak-mis a-zi-iz i-na-ṭa-al-an-ni-ma ú-na-a-⸢ša{?}⸣ [SAG].⸢DU{?}-su⸣
segments.en: I looked at him and my bones shivered! His grimly luminescent splendour overwhelmed me, I kissed the feet of his great divinity and knelt down. Then I stood up, while he looked at me, shaking his head.

segments.orig: [ri]-⸢gim⸣-šu ú-dan-nin-am-ma ki-ma UD-me ⸢še-gi⸣-i ez-zi-iš e-li-ia i-šá-as-si šab-bi-ṭu si-mat DINGIR-ti-šú šá ki-ma ba-áš-me pu-luḫ-tu ma-lu-ú
segments.en: He raised his voice, crying out like a howling storm in fury against me and drawing toward me the sceptre, which is so fitting to his godhead, and which is as dreadful as a viper, to kill me.

segments.orig: [a]-⸢na{?}⸣ ŠÀ-bi-ia i-šá-a-ṭa a-na da-ki-[ia] {d}I.ŠUM ma-lik-šú mu-kil ab-bu-ut-ti KAR-ir ZI-tim ra-ʾi-im ki-na-a-ti ù ki-a-am iq-ta-bi eṭ-lum la tuš-ma-ta LUGAL KI.TIM ⸢DAGAL-tim⸣
segments.en: Išum, his adviser, the intercessor, who spares life, who loves truth, howewer, said thus: "Do not kill the man, O king of the w[id]e underworld!

segments.orig: [x x] ⸢taš{?}⸣-ri-ḫi-i-ka ba-ḫu-la-ti ša KUR DÙ.A.BI lil-tam-mu-ú ŠÀ-bi kaš-ka-ši dan-dan-ni ka-mì-i ḪUL-MEŠ ki-ma A-MEŠ PÚ el-lu-ú-⸢ti⸣ ú-ni-iḫ-[šú]
segments.en: [Let him go, and] may the peoples of all the lands always hear your glorification!" He made the heart of the all-powerful, the almighty one who binds the evil, as calm as pure well water, (and)

segments.en: Nergal (relented), saying thus: "Why did you insult my beloved wife, the queen of the nether world?

segments.orig: [i]-⸢na⸣ qí-bit-i-šá ṣi-ir-ti ša la ut-tak-ka-ru {d}bi-ib-⸢bu{*}⸣ GÍR.LAL KI.TIM a-[na] {d}LUGAL.SU.LA Ì.DU₈ lip-qid-ka-ma KÁ {d}INNIN {d}A.A ú-še-ṣi-[ka]
segments.en: "[B]y her high command, which cannot be changed, may Bibbu, the hangman of the underworld, turn you over to the porter, Lugalsula, that he may let you out of the gate of Ištar and Aya.

segments.orig:
[la] ⸢tam{?}-ta⸣-ši-ma la tu-maš-šar-an-ni-ma di-in ka-ra-ši-i ul a-ša-am i-na qí-bit {d}šá-maš ip-pi-ru da-ṣa-a-ti ù saḫ-ma-šá-a-[ti]
[x x]+⸢x⸣ il{*}-te-niš lid-di-ba-ni-ka-a-ma ina ḫu-bur-ri-ši-⸢na šam⸣-ra-a-ti a.a ir-ḫi-i-ka ši-it-⸢tú⸣
segments.en: "Do not forget or neglect me! Then I will not pass a verdict of annihilation on you. (But) on the command of Šamaš, may distress, acts of violence and rebellion together blow you down so that, by their oppressive clamour, sleep may not come to you.

segments.orig: [LÚ.ÚŠ] an-nu-ú šá ina KI.TIM ta-am-ru ša re-ʾe-e šit-ra-ḫi ša AD-ia ⸢AN⸣.[ŠÁR] LUGAL DINGIR-MEŠ ú-šam-ṣu-u ma-la lib-bu-⸢šú{?}⸣
segments.en: "This [corpse] which (lies) buried in the underworld, is that of the proud shepherd who fulfilled the wishes of my father [Aššur], the king of the gods;

segments.orig: [LUGAL] ⸢šá⸣ ul-tu a-ṣe-e {d}šam-ši a-di e-reb—{d}UTU-ši ma-ta-a-ti nap-ḫar-ši-na ki-ma qé{*}-e{*} uš-tab-ru-ú-ma i-⸢be⸣-lu gi-im-⸢ru⸣
segments.en: "[The king wh]o from east and west made all the lands be looked upon as booty, who ruled everything;

segments.en: "[For wh]om Aššur, at the beginning of his office as high priest, [dec]reed the building of the holy Akitu House of the plain, surrounded by a garden of abundance, the likeness of Mount Lebanon, ...... for ever and ever;

segments.orig: [i-ši]-mu-šú-ma {d}ia-ab-ru ⸢{d}⸣ḫum-ba {d}nap-ru-šú zu-mur-šú na-aṣ-ru ú-šal-la-mu NUMUN-šú um-man-šú KI.KAL-šú ú-še-za-bu [i]-⸢na⸣ tam-ḫa-ri LÚ.nar{?}-ka{?}-ba-ti la iq-ru-ba{?}-⸢áš{?}-šú{?}⸣
segments.en: "Whose body Yabru, Humban and Naprušu protect, whose progeny they keep healthy, and whose army and camp they rescued so that no charioteer could come near him in battle.

segments.orig: [o šu]-ú za-⸢ru⸣-ú-ka ⸢ši{?}⸣-[e]-ḫu mu-de-e a-ma-ti ra-pa-áš uz-ni pal-ku-u ka-ra-áš ta-šim-ti ša GIŠ.ḪUR-MEŠ šá mar-⸢kas⸣ qaq-qa-ri ḫi-i-[ṭu]
segments.en: "He is your father, the eminent one, experienced in matters, wide of understanding, comprehensive in the seat of ordaining fate, who scanned the plans of the mainstay of the earth.

segments.orig: ⸢ša{?}⸣-a ina qa-[bé]-e-šú ip-ḫu-ú ḫa-si-sa-šú a-sak-ku i-ku-la an-zil-la ú-kab-bi-sa ḫa-an-ṭiš me-lam-me LUGAL-ti-šú gal-tu-ti e-saḫ-ḫap-ku-nu a-di šá-a-[ri]
segments.en: "Who(ever of you) may have closed his ear to his speech, tasted the forbidden, trampled on the consecrated — the luminous splendour of his terrifying majesty will throw you down instantly, until (you are but) wind!

segments.orig: a-ma-tu an-[ni]-tu ki-i gi-iṣ-ṣi ina ŠÀ-bi-ku-nu lu-ú na-da-a-ta at-lak a-na e-la-a-ti a-di a-ḫa-sa-sa-ka iq-ba-[am-ma]
segments.en: "May this word be set like a thorn in your heart! Go forth to the upper world until I think of you!", he said [to me].

segments.orig: a-gal-ti-⸢ma⸣ ki-ma eṭ-li ta-pi-ik da-me šá ina ṣu-ṣe-e i-di-ši-šú it-tan-al-la-ku EN—bir-ki ik-tùm-mu-šú-ma i-tar-⸢ra{?}⸣-ku ŠÀ-bu-u-⸢šú⸣
segments.en: I woke up, and like a man who has let blood, who roams alone in a reed thicket, whom a runner catches up with, so that his heart pounds,

segments.orig: ù ki-ma lil-li-di ŠÁḪ ṣe-eḫ-ru šá ina UGU sin-niš-ti-šú e-lu-ú ŠÀ-bu-šú it-tan-am-pa-ḫu TU₁₅ a-⸢na⸣ KA-šú ù EGIR-šú it-te-ni-iṣ-ṣi
segments.en: or like a just matured young boar, who has mounted on his mate, and whose innards inflate so that he gives out wind from his mouth and backside,

segments.orig: ka-bit-tu ú-šá-aṣ-ri-iḫ-ma u₈-a ŠÀ-bi i-qab-bi ina su-ú-qí šil-ta-ḫiš ú-ṣi-ma ep-ri E.SÍR SILA.DAGAL.LA a-na KA-šú ú-sa-ap ri-ig-mu gal-tu iš-ta-nak-kan u₈-a a.[a]
segments.en: he became inflamed with lamentation and called out, "Woe, my heart!" He flew into the road like an arrow, scooped up into his mouth the dust from street and square, continually letting out terrified shriek, "Woe is me!",

segments.orig: mi-nu-ú an-na-a-ti ta-ši-man-ni ia-a-ši i-šá-as-si qur-di {d}U.GUR {d}EREŠ.KI.GAL ša a-na re-ṣu-ti NUN-ma i-zi-zu ina pa-an ba-ḫu-la-ti KUR—aš-šur.KI mar-ṣi-iš id-da-lál
segments.en: He cried "Why have you decreed this for me?", and in his pain he praised before the peoples of Assyria the mighty deeds of Nergal and Ereškigal, who had come to the aid of the prince.

segments.orig: ù šu-ú LÚ.A.BA ša ina maḫ-re-e ṭa-aʾ-tu im-ḫu-ru ina man-zal-ti AD-šú e-zi-zu i-na uz-ni ni-kil-ti ša {d}É.A ú-šat-li-mu-šú
segments.en: But also that scribe, who previously had accepted bribes, who occupied the post of his father, with the wise understanding which Ea had given him,

segments.orig: INIM{?}.GAR{?}-e di-li-li i-na ŠÀ-bi-šú iš-du-ud-ma ki-a-am ina ṣur-ri-šú iq-bi ma-a áš-šú a-de-e a-na le-mut-ti a.a iṭ-[ḫu]-ni a.a is-niq-u-ni
segments.en: he took the words of praise to heart and spoke to himself: "So that the (curses of) the treaty may not come near me to do (me) evil, and may not threaten me,

segments.en: let me always carry out my actions as [Nergal] has ordered!" He went and repeated it to the palace, saying: "Let this be my expiation!"
